title: Conversion Grace Credit for Student Club and Heroes Club Memberships
content:
The conversion grace credit of Northgate Memberships arises when an expired Northgate Student Club Membership or Northgate Heroes Club Membership is renewed and converts because its status verification has run out.

**Rule.** A renewal that converts a Student Club or Heroes Club membership because its status verification is not valid on the first day of the new membership year earns a conversion grace credit of 10.00 dollars when the verification ended no more than 60 days before that first day, 5.00 dollars when it ended 61 to 180 days before it, and nothing when it ended earlier; a renewal that does not convert for that reason earns no conversion grace credit. The credit is taken off the renewal fee of the lapsed membership.

**Q. What is "the first day of the new membership year" here?**
A. The day after the lapsed expiry date when the renewal keeps its anniversary, and the date the renewal fee is paid when it does not.

**Q. How is "ended N days before that first day" counted?**
A. In calendar days from the date through which the verification was valid, as shown on the membership, to the first day of the new membership year. A verification valid through 30 June ended 1 day before a year starting 1 July.

**Q. What are the bands?**

| Days between the end of the verification and the first day of the new year | Conversion grace credit |
|---|---|
| 1 to 60 | 10.00 |
| 61 to 180 | 5.00 |
| more than 180 | none |

**Q. What about a Student Club membership that converts only because it has paid as many Student Club years as its discounted term limit, its verification still being valid on the first day?**
A. It does not convert because its verification is not valid, so it earns no conversion grace credit.

**Q. And a membership that does not convert at all?**
A. No conversion grace credit.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Verification valid through | First day of the new year | Days | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May 2027 | 30 June 2027 | 60 | 10.00 |
| 30 April 2027 | 30 June 2027 | 61 | 5.00 |
| 1 January 2027 | 30 June 2027 | 180 | 5.00 |
| 31 December 2026 | 30 June 2027 | 181 | none |
